query:
SELECT 
  c.name as categoria,
  COUNT(p.id) as total_produtos,
  SUM(p.currentStock) as estoque_total,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN p.currentStock <= p.minimumStock THEN 1 END) as produtos_estoque_baixo
FROM products p
LEFT JOIN categories c ON p.categoryId = c.id
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
ORDER BY total_produtos DESC
